rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); fill_text and stroke_text painted the paragraph top at y minus the unrounded getAlphabeticBaseline() while SkParagraph draws glyphs round(ascent) below that top, so every Canvas2D baseline landed up to half a unit off y; make_paragraph now returns the rounded baseline. PreparedText gains typographic_ascent() and typographic_descent() (fAscent/fDescent, not widened to fTop/fBottom) so Label's captured branch can reproduce Chromium's bottom-minus-round(fDescent) baseline. The Pulp canvas target has not adopted a Vellum package. No API is removed and no design-import, Chromium, rendering-backend, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'fill_text places the alphabetic baseline at y'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'Label honors Chromium captured vertical line positions'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'native codegen preserves the browser'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'lifetime counters advance once per view'
